  spatial_pid=$(ssh bjb1-32546 "ps -p 355687 -o pid= 2>/dev/null" || echo "")
  long_pid=$(ssh bjb1-32546 "ps -p 357618 -o pid= 2>/dev/null" || echo "")
  
  if [ "$goal_tasks" != "$last_goal" ] || [ "$spatial_tasks" != "$last_spatial" ] || [ "$long_tasks" != "$last_long" ]; then
    echo "PROGRESS: Goal=$goal_tasks/10 Spatial=$spatial_tasks/10 Long=$long_tasks/10"
    last_goal=$goal_tasks
    last_spatial=$spatial_tasks
    last_long=$long_tasks
  fi
  
  if [ -z "$goal_pid" ] && [ -z "$spatial_pid" ] && [ -z "$long_pid" ]; then
    echo "ALL_DONE: All three evaluations have completed"
    break
  fi
  
  if [ -z "$goal_pid" ] && [ "$goal_tasks" -gt 0 ]; then

  fi
  if [ -z "$spatial_pid" ] && [ "$spatial_tasks" -gt 0 ]; then

  fi
  if [ -z "$long_pid" ] && [ "$long_tasks" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "FINISHED: Long eval completed with $long_tasks tasks"
  fi
  
  sleep 60
done
